name: Caffè Beluna
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Caffè Beluna in Tirol!**

Discover the cozy charm of this historic café in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where every visit feels like stepping into a bygone era. Savor authentic Italian coffee and indulge in delicious pastries, from fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** to rich **Apfelstrudel**.

Our elegant setting, with its vintage decor and warm ambiance, makes it the perfect spot for a leisurely breakfast, a romantic coffee date, or a quiet afternoon escape. Whether you're exploring the stunning **Tiroler Alpen** or simply unwinding in the city, Caffè Beluna offers a taste of Italy right in the heart of the **Alps**.

Come experience the blend of Italian flair and **Tiroler** hospitality—where every sip and bite tells a story. **Benvenuti a Caffè Beluna!**
